endpointFile.description: Path to the private endpoint descriptor written by the gdebug module (GDEBUG_SERVER_ENDPOINT_FILE / GDEBUG_CLIENT_ENDPOINT_FILE). Contains a secret token: keep it owner-only.

endpoint.description: Optional loopback host:port override, e.g. the local end of an SSH forward. The token still comes from endpointFile.

realm.description: Asserts the target realm; attach fails if the endpoint is the other realm.

allowHookReplacement.description: Required consent: attaching replaces the target's Lua debug hook (GMod's infinite-loop watchdog and profilers stop while attached). Restored on detach.

sourceMaps.description: Explicit local/remote source roots; longest prefix wins. Without a match, paths under lua/ or gamemodes/ map by GMod's virtual root.
